scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,frontend,backend "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
